title: Add VPC control plane Terraform module: multi-AZ subnets, interface endpoints, SGs, peering, Route53
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Add a reusable Terraform module to provision the VPC control plane for Private deployments (multi-AZ). This implements opinionated defaults for subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, cross-account VPC peering, and Route53 private hosted zone / DNS peering to support Private/VPC control plane topology used by the private installer. The goal is to standardize our control-plane network footprint across cloud accounts and speed up onboarding for customers using Redwood Private.

add: multi-az subnet logic + az mappings
feat: interface endpoints for SSM, EC2, KMS, ECR + endpoint policies
chore: security groups for control plane (allow internal agent/control-plane traffic)
feat: cross-account VPC peering resources, peering accepter module
feat: Route53 private hosted zone + zone association + resolver rules for peering
tests: add terratest fixtures + simple plan assertions
docs: README, usage examples and migration notes

modules/vpc-control-plane/variables.tf - variables for azs, cidr, tags
modules/vpc-control-plane/security_groups.tf - control plane SGs and helper rules
modules/vpc-control-plane/peering.tf - cross-account peering resources and data sources
modules/vpc-control-plane/route53.tf - private hosted zone + associations + resolver rules
examples/multi-account/README.md - example usage and IAM guidance
examples/multi-account/main.tf - example root using module (consumer account + control plane account)
docs/vpc-control-plane.md - operational doc for private installer integration
CHANGELOG.md - entry for v1.0.0 of module

merge_commit_message:
Add VPC control plane Terraform module (multi-AZ subnets, endpoints, SGs, peering, Route53)

Implements standardized VPC topology for Redwood Private control plane. Includes examples, tests, and documentation. Updates CHANGELOG.
release_notes:
Adds vpc-control-plane Terraform module (v1.0.0): multi-AZ subnets, interface endpoints for required AWS services, least-privilege security groups, cross-account VPC peering helpers, and Route53 private hosted zone + DNS peering examples.

Operational notes: operators must run peering accepter in the peer account or follow the example automation. See docs/vpc-control-plane.md for migration and upgrade guidance.
notes_on_migration: In-place upgrades should be done with plan review. Avoid changing subnet CIDRs or route table attachments without migration window. Peering resources require coordination across accounts; provide accepter IAM role or run the accepter step in the peer account. Resolver rules may require customer DNS validation. Terraform state import helpers are documented in examples/README.
human_readable_summary: This PR adds a production-ready Terraform module to provision the network elements required for Redwood Private control plane across multiple AZs. It standardizes subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, cross-account peering, and Route53 DNS peering, and includes examples and tests to reduce onboarding friction for private deployments.
